# OpenAI Codex Changelog — captured 2026-06-05

## June 4, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.137.0 (NEW since prior scan)
- Hosted web and image tools available in code-mode flows, with parallel web search capability. (NEW autonomous web-egress/tool surface)
- Multi-agent v2 enhancements with runtime choice persistence per thread. (NEW)
- Remote-control clients can manage pairing and controller grants via app-server RPCs. (NEW remote-control authorization surface)
- Enterprise/admin flows display monthly credit limits and cloud-managed config bundles.
- Plugin workflows gained machine-readable JSON output and cached remote catalog suggestions.
- F13-F24 keybindings and paste support in searchable menus.

## June 4, 2026 — Codex App 26.602 (NEW)
- Activity insights and share cards added to Profile section; shareable profile cards.
- Expanded onboarding with additional role selections.
- Enhanced Computer Use startup readiness and appshot error reporting; browser/review UI fixes.

## June 2, 2026 — Build and deploy websites with Sites (preview) [reported 2026-06-03]
- Sites plugin: create, save, deploy, inspect websites/dashboards/internal tools/web apps/games hosted by OpenAI.
- Cloudflare Worker–compatible ES-module output; per-project hosted env vars/secrets; deployment lifecycle; shareable workspace URL; agent-changeable access controls. Business/Enterprise first.

## June 2, 2026 — ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.146 [reported 2026-06-03]
- Optional Face ID/passcode lock for Codex; SSH connection support for Windows machines.

## June 1, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.136.0 [reported 2026-06-02]
- Amazon Bedrock support (AWS-managed auth via AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK/AWS_REGION or SDK credential chain; SigV4).
- Session archiving via /archive; Windows sandbox provisioning; enhanced TUI markdown rendering.
